title: Sigmoid Derivative
prompt:
The logistic sigmoid is σ(x) = 1/(1+exp(-x)). Differentiate it:

    d/dx [ 1/(1+exp(-x)) ]
hint: use exp(...); the equivalent s*(1-s) form is accepted
recap: The logistic sigmoid σ(x) = 1/(1 + exp(−x)) squashes ℝ into (0, 1). Its derivative is self-referential: σ'(x) = σ(x)(1 − σ(x)), maximal (1/4) at x = 0.
